name: inspira-sparkles
title: Sparkles
description: A canvas field of small white dots scattered over a black surface. They float gently and fade in and out, densest at the top and thinning downward, like slow falling snow or stars.
use: A dark hero or full-bleed section that needs quiet motion behind a headline without stealing attention.
avoid: Runs a canvas loop forever with no reduced-motion pause, and the default background is a hardcoded blue.
a11y: Decorative background with no prefers-reduced-motion check, so the endless drift keeps animating for motion-sensitive users. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Hundreds of tiny white dots are scattered across a near-black backdrop, each a slightly different size and brightness. They are heaviest in the upper band and thin out toward the bottom, giving a soft fade. A large white headline sits above them in the demo.
behaves: Each dot drifts on a slow diagonal velocity and wraps around the edges when it leaves, so the field never empties. A per-dot sine phase makes them pulse dimmer and brighter, producing a gentle twinkle.
customise: Set the background colour, particle colour, count, size range and speed through props; the drift physics and twinkle are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame canvas redraws every dot each frame; the demo runs 900 particles.
demo: A large white heading reading Inspira UI above two faint blue gradient lines and the particle field.
polishWhy: Tidy drifting field with soft fade; the effect is familiar and the dots very slight.
